title: ZZZwallpaper video effects v38
description: 视频画面效果与粒子参数。柔化和物资仓库画面效果已移除；模糊支持可调采样次数。 新增可定位光芒、五种叠加模式及可选星芒、镜头光斑和动态。

RgbOffset.description: Reference pixels at 1080 output height. UI uses actual screen pixels, limited to 10% of selected screen width. Renderer enforces this limit.

ScanlineSpeed.description: cycles per second; positive scrolls down

GlitchStrength.description: fraction; scales strip displacement and chromatic tearing

GlitchRate.description: pattern changes per second; zero freezes pattern

DotStrength.description: blend of original and dot image

DotSpacing.description: pixels at 1080 output height; minimum 2 physical output pixels

DotSize.description: fraction of dot cell; diameter also responds to source luminance

DotGlowStrength.description: local linear-light halo intensity; requires Dots

DotSpeed.description: cells per second; positive flows down-right; zero freezes

DotPulse.description: radius and glow breathing amount; requires Dots and DotMotion

GlitchRgbOffset.description: base glitch RGB separation in pixels at 1080 output height

DotRippleStrength.description: linear-light dot halo and core gain

DotRippleSpeed.description: center-to-corner radii per second; zero freezes rings

DotRippleWidth.description: fraction of center-to-corner radius; effective width capped at .45 / ring count

DotRippleCount.description: concentric ring count along center-to-corner radius

LargeGlitchMode.description: 0 horizontal, 1 vertical, 2 block, 3 automatic shape with perimeter/corner/center placement.

LargeGlitchRate.description: Internal changes per second during a burst; zero freezes each burst pattern, not the burst schedule.

GlitchColorShift.description: Color shift for companion patches, digital glitch and legacy localized cluster only.

GlitchHueShift.description: Fixed small/digital/cluster HSV hue rotation in degrees; unused while GlitchRandomHue is enabled.

LargeGlitchInterval.description: Seconds between burst starts, following continuous video time.

LargeGlitchDuration.description: Seconds per burst; always shorter than the minimum interval.

GlitchRandomHue.description: Random small-glitch hues; companions keep independent hues for the whole burst, digital/cluster colors follow each event.

LargeGlitchHueShift.description: Fixed main-region hue rotation in degrees; unused while LargeGlitchRandomHue is enabled.

LargeGlitchRandomHue.description: A new main-region hue per burst, stable within that burst.

Layers.description: All profiles render as a sequential stack. Null uses the central default order for a display, or inherits display ordering for an asset. Missing stages inherit their display or default layer. Larger values execute later; ties use the central default order.

LargeGlitchVariation.description: Per-burst relative +/- variation; zero retains configured values.

DotShape.description: Circle, square, diamond, triangle, hexagon, star, cross, ring.

RippleDotShape.description: Circle, square, diamond, triangle, hexagon, star, cross, ring.

ZoomTunnel.description: 画面循环向前放大并淡出，下一层从远处放大接入，形成连续穿梭。可调整周期、放大倍率与消失点。

RainRipples.description: 粒子类型为 5 时使用的雨滴涟漪参数，保留旧版配置。

WaterWave.description: 叠加连续流动的两组水波，让画面像透过水面观察时一样轻微摇曳。振幅按 1080p 基准像素计算。

Color.description: 描边颜色；null 沿用旧模式的黑色或白色。

EdgeOutline.description: 检测原始画面的明暗边界并绘制轮廓。可选白色叠加、黑色叠加或黑底白线；阈值越高，保留的轮廓越少。

Pixelate.description: 将画面合并为规则的方形色块，色块越大，细节越少。尺寸按 1080p 基准像素计算。

ColorPositions.description: 空数组按颜色数量均匀分布；非空时必须与 Colors 等长且严格递增。

ConeCorner.description: 0 左上、1 右上、2 左下、3 右下

ConeDirection.description: 0° 沿水平内向，90° 沿垂直内向；45° 指向对角。

ConeLength.description: 照射长度相对画面对角线的比例

SunPrism.description: 阳光色散支持六种形状、中心与移动旋转动画，以及 2–12 个带位置的渐变关键点。

Image.description: Empty, or B1: followed by Base64 Brotli data that expands to exactly 512 x 512 luminance bytes. Legacy raw Base64 is also accepted.

Style.description: 0 circle, 1 petal, 2 glow, 3 soft dot, 4 diamond, 5 rain ripples, 6 star, 7 custom image, 8 Polychrome, 9 Master Tape, 10 Encrypted Master Tape, 11 Denny, 12 Gear Coin, 13 Boopon, 14 Ochre Shard (赭石碎片). Built-in images are 200x200 transparent PNG artwork.

Direction.description: Emission angle: 0 right, 90 down, 180 left, 270 up.

RandomRotation.description: Independent clockwise/counterclockwise rotation and 35-100% of the configured speed per particle birth. Initial angle is independent of position in both modes; zero Rotation remains still.

Quality.description: 0 low (128 particles), 1 medium (512), 2 high (2000); Count is capped by quality.

LocalRegion.description: Restrict area emitter origins to CenterX/Y and Width/Height; point and line emitters always use their coordinates. Particles may travel outside the origin area.

Emission.description: 0 continuous staggered births, 1 simultaneous repeating burst.

BurstInterval.description: Idle seconds after each burst lifetime; burst cycle = Lifetime + BurstInterval.

Spread.description: Angular spread in degrees around Direction.

Gravity.description: Vertical acceleration in pixels/s² at 1080p; positive down.

Image.description: Empty or P1: plus base64 Brotli compressed 512x512 RGBA8 straight-alpha bytes, exactly 1048576 bytes after decompression; preserve aspect ratio with transparent padding. Uploaded locally through the UI. No external file path.

RandomAppearance.description: Choose an appearance from RandomStyles at each particle birth; stable during its lifetime. Style is retained but ignored while random selection is enabled.

RandomStyles.description: Appearance IDs. RandomAppearance requires at least one selection. ID 7 requires a valid uploaded Image. Rain ripples cannot be mixed.

Style.description: 0 circle, 1 petal, 2 glow, 3 soft dot, 4 diamond, 5 rain ripples, 6 star, 7 custom image, 8 Polychrome, 9 Master Tape, 10 Encrypted Master Tape, 11 Denny, 12 Gear Coin, 13 Boopon, 14 Ochre Shard (赭石碎片). Built-in images are 200x200 transparent PNG artwork.

ColorEnabled.description: 启用粒子颜色染色；关闭时保留图片原色，Color 仍保存

SubLayer.description: Independent second particle layer, never emitted by primary particles. Own appearance, emitter, movement and per-layer quality cap; composited after the primary layer under the same effect mask and strength. Disabled by default. No recursive layers.

ColorEnabled.description: 启用粒子颜色染色；关闭时保留图片原色，Color 仍保存

BlurSamples.description: 每个滤波方向的采样次数；越高越平滑，GPU 开销越大。

BlendMode.description: 0 滤色、1 线性减淡、2 正常、3 叠加、4 柔光

Mode.description: 0 horizontal tearing; 1 displaced blocks; 2 thin jitter strips; 3 RGB ghosting
